memory_candidates: nf_x_eq (all witnesses of a 2-var NF share the same 1-var type) is FALSE. Different models can satisfy the same 2-var sub_nf with different 1-var types for the existential witness. The formula char_kp1(nf_x₀) for a single M₀ NF type fails in the forward direction.

const_env_determined (1-var NF type determines 2-var NF type on constant envs [t,t]) is FALSE. Counterexample: model with 2 elements has existentials that model with 1 element lacks, even with the same 1-var type.

nf_extend_fwd/bwd loses one depth level per arity increase. Depth-(k'+2) arity-1 agreement gives depth-(k'+1) arity-2, then depth-k' arity-3. But quantifier conditions of sub_nf at depth k'+2 need depth-(k'+1) arity-3 — one level short.
component_extend_fwd (NEquivalence.lean:187) replicated as nf_extend_fwd in KampBypass.lean. Public standalone version avoids needing to modify NEquivalence.lean.

ExistPart(k) at constant parent envs [t,t] does NOT directly help for non-constant parent envs [x,t] where x != t. Until/Since zones require Prior compositionality (Rabinovich Lemma 5.1) or nested temporal encoding.

The backward direction of existPart_succ_n1_bypass at k>0 fundamentally requires encoding 2-var NF quantifier conditions into the temporal formula. The 1-var type (compat_disj) is necessary but NOT sufficient.
